summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi AI Cybersecurity ETF (XA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme.  The fund actively selects companies across the global AI-driven cybersecurity sector. It seeks capital appreciation and combines fundamental analysis, thematic screening, and quantitative methods in selecting securities. XA was launched on May 6, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: XA is an equity ETF with a total of 29 individual holdings. The top holdings are OTHER ASSETS AND LIABILITIES stock at 13.32%, Palo Alto Networks at 12.10%, CrowdStrike Holdings at 11.23%, Okta, Inc. at 6.87%, and Fortinet at 5.99%.
